title: Word Formation: Why We Need Sleep (poziom rejonowy/wojewodzki)

tasks.instruction: Przeczytaj ponizszy tekst. Uzupelnij kazda luke (1.1-1.8), przeksztalcajac wyraz podany w ramce w taka forme, ktora logicznie i gramatycznie pasuje do kontekstu. Wymagana jest calkowita poprawnosc gramatyczna i ortograficzna wpisywanych wyrazow. Dwa wyrazy zostaly podane dodatkowo i nie pasuja do zadnej luki.
tasks.text: For centuries, 1.1. _________ have tried to understand why humans spend roughly a third of their lives asleep. Studies also show that levels of 1.4. _________ drop sharply after a poor night's sleep, making it harder to learn at school. Going to bed at completely different times each night creates an 1.5. _________ pattern that confuses the body's internal clock. Those who sleep 1.6. _________ and wake refreshed tend to perform better in tests. A short afternoon nap can be surprisingly 1.7. _________ for both memory and mood. Worryingly, researchers warn that years of poor sleep may even lead to 1.8. _________ lifespans.
